description.value:
Duration while the duel lasts

Once your marked target has attacked you three times this encounter, you automatically know the result of its attacks against you before it rolls, and may Step as a free action once per round in response. Against that target you also treat any critical failure on your own attack rolls as an ordinary failure.

cinderfall.incomplete: After 3 rounds of the mark attacking the caster: know the result of its attacks before they're rolled, and may Step free in response once/round; treat critical failures against the mark as ordinary failures. No rule element grants precognition of another creature's not-yet-rolled result -- no analog anywhere in the engine -- and this headline mechanic gates the whole package, so the card nets INCOMPLETE even though the crit-fail-downgrade half alone (self-only AdjustDegreeOfSuccess) would otherwise be buildable.
